heading: Focused on AI Smart Sorting in Scan-to-Task Process

blocks.html: After analyzing the features of mainstream competitors and users’ needs with the PM, he insisted on incorporating AI smart sorting into our scan-to-task process. He believed it could efficiently address user pain points, enabling them to quickly complete their daily tasks. I linked the wireframes in a flow to better understand interactions, bringing clarify and tangibility to the product decisions.
